# crosswork_static_route (Resource)

This resource can manage a static route for Zero Touch Provisioning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_static_route" "example" {
  address       = "192.0.2.0"
  prefix_length = 24
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Address of the route
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the route
  - Range: `0`-`128`

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_static_route.example "<id>"
```
